title: Salidroside alleviates sepsis-associated acute lung injury through modulation of the ERK/FoxO3a signaling axis and improvement of impaired autophagic flux.
authors: Ma, Xiangli; Zhang, Yurong; Huang, Zhenzhen; Zhang, Ling; Lin, Yujie; Fu, Xu; Li, Peiwu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究红景天苷通过ERK/FoxO3a信号轴改善脓毒症相关急性肺损伤的自噬流，属于纯湿实验与药理机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Sepsis-associated acute lung injury (ALI) is a major cause of mortality, and its underlying molecular mechanisms remain incompletely understood. Impaired autophagic flux is considered an important pathological event in this process. Salidroside (Sal), a natural bioactive compound, exhibits anti-inflammatory and cytoprotective effects; however, its role in sepsis-associated ALI requires further investigation. METHODS: Network pharmacology and molecular docking were employed to identify potential targets and explore candidate signaling pathways. In vitro and in vivo models of sepsis-associated ALI were established using lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-treated RLE-6TN cells and cecal ligation and puncture (CLP) in rats, respectively. Western blotting, immunofluorescence, Ad-mCherry-GFP-LC3B assay, transmission electron microscopy, and JC-1 staining were performed to assess the ERK/FoxO3a signaling pathway, autophagic flux, and mitochondrial function. Phorbol 12-myristate 13-acetate (PMA), an ERK activator, was used for mechanistic validation. RESULTS: Network pharmacology analysis suggested that the ERK/FoxO3a signaling axis may be involved in the effects of Sal. Experimental results showed that Sal reduced inflammatory responses and attenuated lung injury in both in vitro and in vivo models. Sepsis was associated with impaired autophagic flux, as indicated by increased LC3-II/LC3-I ratio and p62 accumulation, whereas Sal treatment decreased p62 levels and promoted autolysosome formation, suggesting improvement of impaired autophagic flux. In addition, Sal reduced ERK phosphorylation and was associated with increased nuclear localization of FoxO3a. PMA partially attenuated the effects of Sal on ERK/FoxO3a-related changes, autophagy-associated markers, and mitochondrial function. CONCLUSIONS: Salidroside exerts protective effects in sepsis-associated ALI, which may be associated with modulation of the ERK/FoxO3a signaling axis, improvement of impaired autophagic flux, and maintenance of mitochondrial function.
abstract_zh: 背景：脓毒症相关急性肺损伤（ALI）是死亡的主要原因，其潜在分子机制尚未完全阐明。自噬流受损被认为是该过程中的重要病理事件。红景天苷（Sal）是一种天然生物活性化合物，具有抗炎和细胞保护作用；然而，其在脓毒症相关ALI中的作用仍需进一步研究。方法：采用网络药理学和分子对接技术识别潜在靶点并探索候选信号通路。分别利用脂多糖（LPS）处理的RLE-6TN细胞和大鼠盲肠结扎穿刺（CLP）建立脓毒症相关ALI的体外和体内模型。通过Western blotting、免疫荧光、Ad-mCherry-GFP-LC3B检测、透射电子显微镜和JC-1染色评估ERK/FoxO3a信号通路、自噬流和线粒体功能。使用ERK激活剂佛波醇12-肉豆蔻酸酯13-乙酸酯（PMA）进行机制验证。结果：网络药理学分析提示ERK/FoxO3a信号轴可能参与Sal的作用。实验结果显示，Sal在体外和体内模型中均减少了炎症反应并减轻了肺损伤。脓毒症与自噬流受损相关，表现为LC3-II/LC3-I比值升高和p62积累，而Sal处理降低了p62水平并促进了自噬溶酶体形成，提示改善了受损的自噬流。此外，Sal降低了ERK磷酸化，并与FoxO3a核定位增加相关。PMA部分减弱了Sal对ERK/FoxO3a相关变化、自噬相关标志物和线粒体功能的影响。结论：红景天苷在脓毒症相关ALI中发挥保护作用，这可能与调节ERK/FoxO3a信号轴、改善受损的自噬流以及维持线粒体功能有关。
